objective: Make the 32-frame slope review packet directly navigable in LabelAgent while preserving candidate/truth/training isolation and eliminating the stale-prefetch error during dataset switches.

implementation.server_registry: Strictly validates the local manifest schema, source frame hashes, exact MCAP hash, topic, unique frames, and candidate/truth/training flags.
implementation.activation: Loads only the manifest-bound MCAP and topic after a full SHA-256 check and rejects activation while inference is running.
implementation.navigation: The workbench lists all 32 rows, verifies the selected frame through /api/human_review_binding, opens the exact frame, and keeps an unsaved-draft navigation guard.
implementation.completion: Counts only current labelagent.human-review.v2 accepted receipts with exact file, topic, frame hash, and committed truth status.
implementation.scope_switch_fix: All speculative readiness and discovery requests use AbortController and are cancelled before file, topic, registered-source, or review-packet activation. A request that still reaches the server after a scope switch returns a 200 scope_changed no-op with zero writes instead of a 409.
implementation.truth_event: The existing safe truth-save gate emits a completion event only after its binding and readback checks pass. The review packet never calls the truth endpoint itself.

browser_acceptance.environment: Fresh isolated copy of formal state, file sessions, file library, and packet manifest on port 8875.

verification.initial_browser_failure_reproduced: A pre-fix isolated acceptance reached frame 74 but observed POST /api/reference_discovery/prefetch returning 409 after the scope switch.
verification.post_fix_browser_acceptance: Passed with zero page errors, failed requests, HTTP errors, or truth writes.

publication_boundary: Factory images, the local browser result, and the screenshot remain under untracked artifacts and are not uploaded. Source, tests, and non-image structured evidence may be synchronized.
model_training_boundary: This round changes workbench reliability and review throughput only. SAM has not been fine-tuned or post-trained, and the packet does not unlock training until current human receipts exist.
remaining_gate: A human must inspect/correct and explicitly save the selected frames. Model accuracy or fine-tuning claims remain blocked until a current human-reviewed train/evaluation split is available.
